pool.baseline: I've been thinking a lot lately about how much of our "will to live" is just a mindless biological leftover. Like, we're essentially just chemical programs running on a loop because our ancestors didn't die before they could replicate. There's no higher dignity or cosmic reason to keep the loop going, right? It feels like an intellectual failure to just blindly follow that survival instinct when you realize how fundamentally empty the whole thing is.
